title: Finance: switch invoices between All, TD clients and TD Marketing
text: Invoices now belong to a department: TD clients (the default) or TD Marketing, which owns the Marketing sales invoices and their credit notes. Finance has a new switch (All, TD clients, TD Marketing) that filters the All Invoices list, By Client and the selected client's lists. Overview and the header totals still cover both departments.
points: When a Marketing sale is paid, its invoice and credit note are marked TD Marketing automatically.
The 6 older Marketing records were tagged in a separate one-off step.
